what: Bar chart with tabs — each tab holds a set of values (0~1). Pressing a tab slides the white pill behind it to that tab’s position and width in .3s, the five bars grow or shrink to their new lengths in .52s (curve 0.22,1,0.36,1), and the value text on the right changes. It starts at 0 length and fills once when the panel enters 85% of the screen. Left and right arrow keys also move it — for benchmarks and pricing comparison

options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Tab (button) — data-values="0.99,0.97,…" Bars in order, aria-selected=true is the first tab
options.[data-fx-part=pill]: (if any) pill behind the tabs — inside the same position:relative parent as the tabs
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Bars that change length (not filling the track) — several
options.[data-fx-part=value]: (If any) Value text for each bar — same order as the bars

use: …
note: The original bars are a recharts chart — the length curve and length use .52 of the bundle string · 0.22,1,0.36,1 (the pill slide .3s is a guess from the screen)
